{
  "claims": [
    {
      "source_id": "runtime:h200:runtime-inventory",
      "quote": "\"--max-num-seqs\",\n        \"64\"",
      "claim": "Observed deployment configuration is two replicas, each TP1/DP4/EP4, with seq64, DSpark five-token speculation and a 16384-token batch budget.",
      "relation": "context",
      "conditions": "H200; DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash revision 2cba9e42aa026125f3ed06c6d98c1db82f7ca027. User-supplied constraints are E384/H5120/I2304/top6, swiglu_limit10 and installed Humming 0.1.16.",
      "reported_result": "The snapshot reports both servers running and healthy. It contains no comparative GPU experiment or serving performance result.",
      "transfer_inference": "Preserve this topology and exact model geometry in comparisons. Two EP4 replicas are not one EP8 group; seq64 is a configured sequence limit, not a measured per-rank GEMM token count.",
      "limitations": "Actual concurrency, per-rank token distributions, expert skew, all2all backend and baseline compute-time breakdown are unknown."
    },
    {
      "source_id": "code:h200-excerpts:compute",
      "quote": "Using 'MARLIN' Mxfp4 MoE backend.",
      "claim": "Observed startup selected MARLIN and MarlinExperts. The installed automatic-priority list omits Humming.",
      "relation": "supports",
      "conditions": "Exact installed source and startup excerpt for the live H200 deployment.",
      "reported_result": "Backend selection is directly evidenced by the startup log. No MARLIN-versus-Humming timing is supplied.",
      "transfer_inference": "Performance hypothesis: explicit --moe-backend humming is the strongest simple backend comparator. A newer upstream claim that Humming is the SM90 default does not describe this installed runtime.",
      "limitations": "The excerpts do not establish whether explicit Humming selection succeeds through this installed model's complete loader and expert path. Benefit over MARLIN is unknown."
    },
    {
      "source_id": "code:h200-excerpts:compute",
      "quote": "env_gemm_type: str | None = envs.VLLM_HUMMING_MOE_GEMM_TYPE",
      "claim": "Observed selector code gives the environment override precedence; otherwise EP selects grouped_contiguous and non-EP selects indexed.",
      "relation": "supports",
      "conditions": "Relevant after selecting Humming. The live deployment uses EP4.",
      "reported_result": "Implementation evidence establishes an existing selection mechanism, not execution or speed.",
      "transfer_inference": "Performance hypotheses: compare MARLIN with Humming at unchanged activation precision, then compare Humming grouped against VLLM_HUMMING_MOE_GEMM_TYPE=indexed. Explicitly fixing the GEMM type avoids confusing backend activation with a default-policy change.",
      "limitations": "Compatibility of indexed execution with the live communication path and its effect size remain unknown. The override does not activate Humming while MARLIN remains selected."
    },
    {
      "source_id": "github:vllm-project/vllm:59488:patch",
      "quote": "and (not parallel.use_all2all_kernels or parallel.use_ag_rs_all2all_kernels)",
      "claim": "Observed patch code narrows automatic indexed selection to MXFP4, DeepSeek V4 routing, deepseek_v41/deepseek_v41_text, CUDA SM90, and no all2all kernels or allgather_reducescatter.",
      "relation": "supports",
      "conditions": "The environment override retains precedence. Other EP configurations retain grouped selection.",
      "reported_result": "The supplied implementation establishes the dispatch predicate. Its docstring claims indexed is faster; the patch supplies no timing result.",
      "transfer_inference": "Performance hypothesis: indexed Humming is a well-motivated comparator for this model, conditional on communication compatibility. The existing override can test it without first adopting the automatic-selection patch.",
      "limitations": "Live all2all selection is unknown. The automatic rule excludes DeepEP; an environment override bypassing that rule is not evidence of supported execution."
    },
    {
      "source_id": "github:vllm-project/vllm:59488:live-page",
      "quote": "Humming takes the named format as a fixed input schema, with its input-schema fallback off.",
      "claim": "The author separates GEMM selection from activation precision and describes enforcing named activation formats instead of silently substituting another format.",
      "relation": "supports",
      "conditions": "Reported startup validation uses 8x H200, TP8+EP, Humming and DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash; the per-token FP8 startup includes DSpark with one speculative token.",
      "reported_result": "The author reports successful startup and one completion with indexed Humming and fp8_per_token, plus 41 selected MoE tests passing on H200. The supplied excerpt describes grouped/indexed throughput workloads but truncates before their results; the performance effect size is unknown.",
      "transfer_inference": "Proposed correctness gate: confirm the actual backend, expert class and activation schema in startup logs. Treat BF16 versus per-token FP8 as a separate precision arm at fixed GEMM selection; use the named option only where its implementation is present.",
      "limitations": "One completion is not model-quality validation. TP8+EP and one speculative token differ from live TP1/DP4/EP4 and DSpark five. Named-format support in the installed build is unknown."
    },
    {
      "source_id": "github:vllm-project/vllm:60600:live-page",
      "quote": "humming-kernels 0.1.16 refuses the pair.",
      "claim": "The reported schema rejection directly challenges enabling MXFP4 weights with group-128 FP8 activations and float32 scales on installed Humming 0.1.16.",
      "relation": "challenges",
      "conditions": "vLLM d5ee309, Humming 0.1.16, H200 SM90, CUDA 13.0. Group-wise FP4 compatibility requires scale types incompatible with the requested float32 group scales.",
      "reported_result": "The author reports rejection with fallback disabled and substitution to per-token FP8 when fallback is allowed. MXFP8 with e8m0 input scales passes schema compatibility but has no legal SM90 WGMMA schedule. A maintainer states that 0.1.17 will fix the schema issue.",
      "transfer_inference": "Proposed correctness gate: exclude block-FP8 activation from the current 0.1.16 comparison unless actual compatibility and the resolved schema are established. Issue closure and a promised newer release do not repair the installed package. Current #59488 also rejects these unsupported named formats early.",
      "limitations": "The maintainer comment does not establish installed 0.1.17 behavior, MXFP8 kernel support or performance. The separate reproduction used RTX 4090 for schema preflight, not H200 serving."
    },
    {
      "source_id": "github:vllm-project/vllm:60600:live-page",
      "quote": "group-wise input scales are much slower than per-token on WGMMA",
      "claim": "Reported dense-GEMM measurements challenge the assumption that finer activation-scale groups improve Hopper performance.",
      "relation": "challenges",
      "conditions": "H200, MXFP4 weights, dense GEMM M=4096/N=2048/K=4096; compatibility checks bypassed for group-wise float32 scales.",
      "reported_result": "The author reports 535.7 us for group 128 and 1720 us for group 32, versus 72.2 us for per-token FP8 and 110.9 us for BF16. Bypassed group-128 execution reportedly matches the reference at error 0.0017–0.0032.",
      "transfer_inference": "Performance hypothesis: per-token FP8 is a more defensible initial precision comparator than block FP8. A compatible group-scale kernel can still be slower.",
      "limitations": "This is a dense probe with different dimensions from E384/H5120/I2304/top6, not routed EP4 MoE or serving. The error metric definition, model-quality impact and live effect size are unknown."
    },
    {
      "source_id": "github:vllm-project/vllm:61875:live-page",
      "quote": "DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash was not run",
      "claim": "The author attributes a block-FP8 activation benefit to full-size experts under EP, while reporting regressions when TP shards the intermediate dimension.",
      "relation": "supports",
      "conditions": "DeepSeek-V4-Flash on 4x H200, TP4+EP, H4096/I2048; FP8 measured through an environment override. Decode uses 512 input/1024 output tokens at concurrency 128.",
      "reported_result": "Reported results are approximately +25% decode throughput and +6.4% prefill-heavy throughput with EP, but -0.4% at low concurrency and -15% decode without EP. GSM8K changes from 0.951 to 0.948, characterized by the author as noise.",
      "transfer_inference": "Performance hypothesis: activation precision may help full-size EP experts, but it requires an independent arm after selecting the GEMM path. These results do not estimate improvement for H5120/I2304 or indexed V4.1 execution.",
      "limitations": "Strong contrary evidence is #60600 and current #59488: installed 0.1.16 rejects the claimed block-FP8 pair. The benchmark's Humming version and actual resolved schema are unknown, so fallback or a different build remains possible. The exact PR build was not rerun end to end."
    },
    {
      "source_id": "github:vllm-project/vllm:61461:patch",
      "quote": "return 12, hidden_size // 512, 256",
      "claim": "Observed patch code adds an SM90-specific fused mHC configuration for at most eight tokens, replacing the inherited GB300-oriented selection in that band.",
      "relation": "supports",
      "conditions": "CUDA SM90, hidden_size divisible by 512, and hc_mult*(hc_mult+2) divisible by 12. For H5120 and hc_mult=4, the candidate configuration is (12,10,256), versus installed (2,8,128).",
      "reported_result": "The patch establishes the selector and adjusts warmup enumeration to compile selected variants. It contains no measurement.",
      "transfer_inference": "Performance hypothesis: reduce repeated post-mapping work by using fewer projection tiles and different thread/split allocation. Preserve H5120 rather than substituting another model's hidden size.",
      "limitations": "Eligibility depends on actual kernel token count, not seq64. The patch leaves 9–32-token selection unchanged; above 32 tokens the selector returns the separate-kernel path. Live hc_mult and token-band occupancy are not shown in the inventory."
    },
    {
      "source_id": "github:vllm-project/vllm:61461:live-page",
      "quote": "H100/H200.\nThese GPUs are not measured.",
      "claim": "H20 measurements support the small-token mHC launch change, but challenge treating its gain as established for H200 or saturated serving.",
      "relation": "supports",
      "conditions": "H20, hc_mult=4, CUDA graphs, cold L2; H5120 uses the V4.1 delayed fused kernel. Serving validation uses 8x H20, TP8, 1K input/1K output and DSpark five.",
      "reported_result": "The author reports 9.1–14.1% lower H5120 operator latency at 1–8 tokens. C1 serving improves output throughput about 0.9% and TPOT p50 about 1%; C64 shows no separated gain. Residual streams are bit-identical, while coefficients differ in FP32 summation order.",
      "transfer_inference": "Performance hypothesis: retain this as a targeted small-batch candidate, conditional on live time spent in the eligible band. Proposed correctness gate: validate coefficients, layer inputs and warmup behavior independently of timing.",
      "limitations": "H200 benefit is unknown. A pre-existing H7168/M128 test fails in both arms. GSM8K 1274/1319 versus 1276/1319 does not prove numerical or generation equivalence."
    },
    {
      "source_id": "github:deepseek-ai/DeepGEMM:448:live-page",
      "quote": "waiting for completion before reusing A registers",
      "claim": "The author identifies an asynchronous WGMMA register-reuse race in SM90 TF32 mHC prenorm and fixes operand lifetime by waiting after committing the batch.",
      "relation": "supports",
      "conditions": "SM90 tf32_hc_prenorm_gemm; regression coverage includes split-K, PDL and side streams. Exact validation GPU model is unknown.",
      "reported_result": "The author reports tests/test_hyperconnection.py passing on an SM90 GPU. The visible code includes warpgroup_wait<0>() after commit.",
      "transfer_inference": "Proposed correctness gate: establish that the installed JIT header contains the repair, then require independent numerical-reference and repeatability checks before evaluating TF32-based overlap.",
      "limitations": "No throughput effect size is reported. A review bot's double-buffering suggestion is a performance hypothesis, not tested evidence. Installed dependency inclusion and whole-model determinism are unknown."
    },
    {
      "source_id": "github:vllm-project/vllm:59129:live-page",
      "quote": "There is no throughput improvement claim for this correctness repair.",
      "claim": "The PR packages the existing DeepGEMM register-lifetime repair and supplies stronger regression evidence; it is a correctness prerequisite rather than a performance optimization.",
      "relation": "supports",
      "conditions": "GPU results were recorded on H20/v0.30 before the PR split. Cases cover 256/512/1024 tokens, split-K variations, default/side streams and independent FP32 references.",
      "reported_result": "The original header reportedly fails the regression; the repaired header passes six cases. A 12-shape/seed audit with five repeats is exactly repeatable after repair. The broader suite has 17 passed, 9 skipped and one unchanged failure. Installation-fixture checks pass.",
      "transfer_inference": "Proposed correctness gate: verify the installed artifact, not merely repository source or PR existence, and use the same corrected baseline in performance comparisons.",
      "limitations": "No full wheel build or latest-main GPU rerun was performed. Historical GLM evaluation is a small diagnostic, and kernel repeatability does not establish whole-model token determinism."
    },
    {
      "source_id": "github:vllm-project/vllm:60768:live-page",
      "quote": "These mock capability checks validate dispatch only.",
      "claim": "The draft proposes explicit SM90 coefficient-overlap activation while retaining the existing TF32 arithmetic; it does not port compensated BF16.",
      "relation": "challenges",
      "conditions": "Opt-in enable_mhc_overlap=true; existing DeepGEMM, shape, ubatching, FULL CUDA graph and small-batch restrictions remain. The 16-token threshold comes from GB200 measurements.",
      "reported_result": "Fourteen CPU dispatch tests pass. Hopper replay, numerical correctness, quality and performance validation remain pending; the source makes no speedup claim.",
      "transfer_inference": "Proposed correctness gates: confirm the TF32 repair, stream ordering, repeated graph replay, fallback paths and model quality before treating overlap as eligible. At live TP1/EP4, the SM100-only TP collective fusion is inapplicable; any benefit must come from other overlapped work.",
      "limitations": "The installed source excludes SM90. GPU benefit, contention cost and an appropriate Hopper token threshold are unknown. The draft also reports merge conflicts."
    },
    {
      "source_id": "github:sgl-project/sglang:39664:live-page",
      "quote": "three bf16 weight components, one activation read",
      "claim": "The author describes compensated mHC projections using FP32 weights decomposed into BF16 components, plus shared slice reduction and Sinkhorn normalization.",
      "relation": "context",
      "conditions": "DeepSeek-V4.1 mHC; reported BF16x3 comparisons use K=20480 and M=4096/5000/8192. Hardware for those comparisons is unknown.",
      "reported_result": "The author reports bitwise agreement with previous standalone implementations. A later H100 CI rerun passes two existing kernel test files; the description identifies those files as covering untouched kernels. No isolated speedup is supplied.",
      "transfer_inference": "This supplies a numerical approach worth understanding, not proof that a vLLM port is correct or faster. Fixed-slice batch-invariance claims must be distinguished from equality to an independent high-precision reference.",
      "limitations": "The supplied source is a PR narrative rather than kernel bodies. Coverage of the new compensated paths by the cited CI files is not established, and isolated performance is unknown."
    },
    {
      "source_id": "github:sgl-project/sglang:41251:live-page",
      "quote": "mHC statistics, and padded Marlin MoE projections",
      "claim": "The author identifies several Hopper inefficiencies and reports a bundle addressing dense GEMMs, indexer work, mHC projection/overlap, activation fusion and Marlin padding.",
      "relation": "supports",
      "conditions": "8x H200, SGLang TP8/EP1, Marlin MoE, decode graph maximum batch64; random 8192-input/1024-output requests, concurrency 1–64, three alternating paired sweeps.",
      "reported_result": "The bundle reports approximately 2.06–2.35x output throughput per GPU and 2.17–2.48x user speed across tested concurrencies. Accuracy results vary across evaluations and do not establish identical generations.",
      "transfer_inference": "Performance hypotheses: preserve activation-rounding boundaries, avoid unnecessary padding, and investigate independent coefficient work. The bundled gain cannot be assigned to compensated BF16 or overlap alone, or used as an estimate for vLLM.",
      "limitations": "TP8/EP1 differs substantially from live TP1/DP4/EP4. Runtime, graph behavior and other optimized operators differ. No component ablation establishing mHC's share is supplied; #60777 provides contrary evidence for the direct vLLM BF16x3 port."
    },
    {
      "source_id": "github:vllm-project/vllm:60777:live-page",
      "quote": "not a performance win in the tested shapes",
      "claim": "The later H20 validation supersedes the draft's earlier CPU-only status and directly challenges adopting this compensated-BF16 vLLM implementation.",
      "relation": "challenges",
      "conditions": "H20 SM90; M=1/32/256/8192, K=5120/20480, splits=1/4/16, candidate token tiles 32/64/128; tuned DeepGEMM comparator.",
      "reported_result": "The closing report gives 11 GPU tests passed and one failed: four of 792 projection elements exceed unchanged tolerance at M33/K20480/splits1/tile64. Precision/repeatability-filtered candidates are approximately 1.69–3.24x slower in hot-cache measurements; L2-flush retests are also slower.",
      "transfer_inference": "Performance selection: deprioritize this implementation despite SGLang's bundled gains. Proposed correctness gate: require the original numerical suite to pass before considering any revised candidate, then compare the complete fused mHC boundary.",
      "limitations": "H200 execution and serving performance are unknown. Serving dispatch was not wired. Prepared weights cost six bytes per original element plus any retained original; projection timings exclude preparation, allocation and the common epilogue. The closing excerpt truncates during its baseline-repair description."
    },
    {
      "source_id": "github:vllm-project/vllm:62603:live-page",
      "quote": "This PR runs block-FP8 MoE checkpoints on Hopper",
      "claim": "The proposed SM90 integration targets block-FP8 weights, while the described existing DeepGEMM MegaMoE path requires SM100. It is not direct native-MXFP4 V4.1 evidence.",
      "relation": "challenges",
      "conditions": "FlashInfer 0.7.2 SM90 FP8 MegaMoE through flashinfer_moe_ep_cutedsl. The described pull kernel supports a SwiGLU clamp; the FP8 push kernel lacks one.",
      "reported_result": "The source reports GLM block-FP8 execution and refers to separate converted-FP4 and DeepGEMM-fork work. Those references do not supply implementation or validation for the target MXFP4 checkpoint.",
      "transfer_inference": "Proposed eligibility gates: distinguish a block-FP8 weight-conversion branch from both native MXFP4 weights and the separate activation-precision arm. Preserve swiglu_limit10; the described FP8 push branch cannot satisfy that requirement. SM90 TF32 mHC support does not imply SM90 DeepGEMM MegaMoE support.",
      "limitations": "Installed FlashInfer version, exact E384/H5120/I2304/top6 support, conversion memory cost and model-quality impact are unknown. The referenced Hopper DeepGEMM fork is not established as installed or eligible."
    },
    {
      "source_id": "github:vllm-project/vllm:62603:live-page",
      "quote": "Runs are serial A/B/A on the same GPUs.",
      "claim": "Reported GLM results support a fused dispatch/GEMM/combine backend for an eligible block-FP8 workload, but do not establish target-model gains.",
      "relation": "supports",
      "conditions": "Decode: GLM-5.3-Flash, 8x H200 DP8/EP8, 128K input/512 output, MTP3 synthetic acceptance. Prefill: 4x H200 TP2/DP2/EP4, 2048 input/one output, natural MTP3.",
      "reported_result": "The author reports approximately +11–18% decode throughput, +23% saturated prefill throughput and 7–48% lower single-layer latency across tested token counts. At 11 requests/s, prefill TTFT p50 is 10% worse. GSM8K scores are close, not a proof of equivalence.",
      "transfer_inference": "Performance hypothesis: fused communication and expert computation can help an eligible EP branch. These effect sizes cannot be transferred to native MXFP4 V4.1, two EP4 replicas or DSpark verification.",
      "limitations": "Model, weights, topology and speculation differ. Some decode measurements precede later review fixes. Exact shipped geometry and swiglu_limit10 were not demonstrated in the supplied results."
    },
    {
      "source_id": "github:vllm-project/vllm:62603:live-page",
      "quote": "The kernel always processes its whole token buffer",
      "claim": "The author identifies oversized token workspaces as a source of wasted work and adds smaller shared workspace choices.",
      "relation": "supports",
      "conditions": "SM90 FP8 MegaMoE; new workspace capacities are 64, 256 and 1024 tokens, selected using the largest batch across DP ranks.",
      "reported_result": "The author reports that a single max_num_batched_tokens-sized buffer makes decode slower than baseline. No isolated effect size for workspace bucketing is supplied.",
      "transfer_inference": "Performance hypothesis: workspace sizing is essential to evaluating this branch. Proposed correctness gate: every participating rank must select the same buffer, including idle or unevenly loaded ranks; seq64 alone cannot determine that buffer.",
      "limitations": "Without DP-wide counts the adapter uses the default workspace. Exact live rank counts, graph-padding effects and workspace selection are unknown."
    },
    {
      "source_id": "github:vllm-project/vllm:62603:live-page",
      "quote": "Other checkpoints get one extra E4M3 rounding",
      "claim": "The FP8 weight-layout transformation is exact only under the stated scale condition; it can introduce additional rounding for other checkpoints.",
      "relation": "challenges",
      "conditions": "FC1 gate/up rows are interleaved under one 128x128 scale using max(s_gate,s_up). The reported GLM checkpoint has power-of-two scales.",
      "reported_result": "The author states that non-power-of-two checkpoint scales incur an extra rounding on half of FC1 rows. No target-checkpoint conversion result is supplied.",
      "transfer_inference": "Proposed correctness gate: validate the complete target weight conversion, clamp semantics and layer outputs before treating the FP8-weight branch as an equivalent backend comparison.",
      "limitations": "Target scale properties, numerical error, memory footprint and quality after conversion are unknown. This transformation is distinct from changing MoE activation precision."
    },
    {
      "source_id": "github:flashinfer-ai/flashinfer:6517:live-page",
      "quote": "H20 and EP4 plans unchanged",
      "claim": "Reported H200 push-dispatch gains apply to selected EP8 plans; broader expert-count acceptance does not prove the target EP4 geometry is tuned or eligible.",
      "relation": "challenges",
      "conditions": "SM90 FP4 MegaMoE; measured H200 EP8 buckets cover DeepSeek-V4-Flash and MiMo-V2.5-Pro at M<=32, and DeepSeek-V4-Pro at M<=64.",
      "reported_result": "The author reports roughly 10 us saved per call, 1.03–1.16x kernel speedups and bitwise-identical outputs on those plans, plus 68 tests passing on 8x H200.",
      "transfer_inference": "For E384 and EP4, equal partitioning would give 96 experts per rank, satisfying count divisibility only. Full H5120/I2304/top6 geometry, plan shared-memory legality and swiglu_limit10 still determine eligibility. Do not transfer the EP8 push gain.",
      "limitations": "The exact target shape was not reported as measured. FP4 clamp support is unknown from this excerpt. A review bot flags possible launch illegality for newly accepted geometries; its resolution is unknown. The implementation patch was unavailable in the supplied material."
    },
    {
      "source_id": "github:flashinfer-ai/flashinfer:6517:live-page",
      "quote": "otherwise outputs silently saturate or flush",
      "claim": "The author describes checkpoint-conversion preconditions that are necessary for numerically valid FP4 MegaMoE execution.",
      "relation": "supports",
      "conditions": "The low-level layout transform expects Marlin byte order. MXFP4 nonzero groups require decoder scales within 2^-5 through 2^6, with excess moved into per-expert global scales.",
      "reported_result": "The source reports conversion/execution tests and warns that frameworks must prepare checkpoint tensors correctly. It does not report target V4.1 checkpoint conversion.",
      "transfer_inference": "Proposed correctness gate: verify packing, scale redistribution and global-scale application against an independent target-layer reference while retaining E384/H5120/I2304/top6 and swiglu_limit10.",
      "limitations": "Availability of the required converter and loader integration in the installed runtime is unknown. Passing a layout transform alone does not establish end-to-end correctness or performance."
    },
    {
      "source_id": "github:flashinfer-ai/flashinfer:6517:live-page",
      "quote": "left pool blocks ≥ 32 of hot experts stale",
      "claim": "The author reports a repeated-launch failure caused by inactive dispatch warps cleaning workspaces without the expert counts.",
      "relation": "supports",
      "conditions": "SM90 FP4 single_active_dispatch_warp plans; reproduced on 8x H20 with 97–128 tokens per rank and hot-expert routing, including CUDA graph capture.",
      "reported_result": "The hot-expert regression reportedly fails before the fix and passes afterward. Outputs are bitwise unchanged and timing remains within noise.",
      "transfer_inference": "Proposed correctness gate: require the cleanup repair and repeated-launch/graph-replay validation with skewed routing before selecting an affected FP4 branch. This is independent of push-dispatch speed.",
      "limitations": "Affected-plan use in the target EP4 deployment and inclusion of the repair in the installed FlashInfer package are unknown."
    },
    {
      "source_id": "fulltext:2603.19289",
      "quote": "CPU-GPU expert transfers",
      "claim": "The paper addresses expert-weight offloading and prefetching, a different bottleneck from the supplied Hopper compute candidates.",
      "relation": "context",
      "conditions": "Memory-constrained inference using CPU-offloaded experts and YALIS; the excerpt describes consumer and single-GPU datacenter settings without exact benchmark hardware or shapes.",
      "reported_result": "The conclusion claims 5–14% TPOT improvement over on-demand loading. The supplied excerpt does not expose implementation or detailed experimental evidence.",
      "transfer_inference": "Do not use this result to rank Humming, mHC or MegaMoE compute choices without evidence that expert-weight transfers bottleneck the live deployment. Engram cpu_offload in the inventory does not establish expert offloading.",
      "limitations": "Exact hardware, model geometries, transfer volumes, workload and target applicability are unknown. The abstract and gapped conclusion are not implementation evidence."
    }
  ],
  "unanswered": [
    "Does the installed MXFP4 model path accept explicit --moe-backend humming and actually instantiate the intended grouped/indexed experts while preserving E384/H5120/I2304/top6 and swiglu_limit10?",
    "Which all2all backend and kernel path are active? This can change indexed-Humming eligibility and the relevance of #59488's automatic rule.",
    "What activation schema actually runs in each comparator, including any environment override or fallback? The block-FP8 benchmark's Humming version and resolved schema are unknown.",
    "What are the live per-rank token-count, graph-padding and expert-skew distributions under DSpark five? seq64 does not establish occupancy of the mHC 1–8 or overlap <=16 bands.",
    "How much live latency is spent in MARLIN expert GEMMs, mHC, communication and other operators? No profile or new GPU experiment establishes the attainable serving gain.",
    "Does the installed DeepGEMM JIT artifact contain the SM90 register-lifetime repair, and does it pass independent-reference, side-stream and repeated-replay checks?",
    "Does the (12,10,256) mHC configuration improve H200 execution at H5120, and is the required hc_mult=4 confirmed for the live path?",
    "Can coefficient overlap help TP1/EP4 after stream overhead and resource contention, without the SM100 TP collective fusion?",
    "Would a materially revised BF16x3 implementation pass unchanged tolerances and outperform the complete fused baseline on H200? The supplied vLLM implementation currently has contrary H20 evidence.",
    "Which FlashInfer version and SM90 FP4/FP8 branches are installed? Exact geometry support, shared-memory legality, clamp support, loader conversion and cleanup-fix inclusion remain unknown.",
    "Can the target MXFP4 checkpoint be converted to the proposed block-FP8 weight layout within the memory budget while preserving acceptable numerical behavior and swiglu_limit10?",
    "Are DP-wide workspace counts and rank-consistent buffer selection available for each EP4 replica, including idle ranks and graph replay?",
    "What performance and quality differences remain in matched comparisons on the exact live topology? Supplied external results cannot determine the winning backend, precision arm or mHC configuration."
  ]
}
